three_24F_GUT.field_content: three Weyl fermionic SU5 24_F with diagonal generation matrices M0 and K times a single 24_H vev
three_24F_GUT.neutrino_limit: Example diagonal Yukawas reconstruct imported splittings; PMNS, type-I singlet mixings, CP phases, radiative masses and leptogenesis remain free.
three_24F_GUT.result: Three complementary flavor projectors evade the TWO-24_F light-X singular-value obstruction while refitting all 24_F thresholds at ONE LOOP.
three_24F_GUT.not_solved: Chosen MU and mass matrix alignments, 10^-12-ish cancellations, Higgs/scalar thresholds, 2-loop RGE, proton lifetime, PMNS, scalar vacuum and actual unified UV dynamics are NOT predicted.

E8_discrete_R_candidate.symmetry: candidate Z4^R, W charge2, all eight charged singlets charge0, three 16s charge1
E8_discrete_R_candidate.nonprediction: This establishes a tree-level *moduli branch*, not a stabilized finite VEV, mass hierarchy, physical E8 wavefunction overlap or a fully anomaly-free discrete gauge symmetry.
E8_discrete_R_candidate.risk: Mixed Abelian/gravitational discrete anomalies, Green-Schwarz inflow, supergravity constant W, anomalous U1 FI terms, additional neutral fields and nonperturbative R breaking require a separate UV audit.

E8_driving_field_singlet_vacuum.driving_fields: two gauge-neutral chiral multiplets X_A,X_B of Z4R charge2
E8_driving_field_singlet_vacuum.naive_abelian_residual_gauge_stabilizer: Z4 if the gauge group is U1^3 with primitive weight-character lattice
E8_driving_field_singlet_vacuum.global_group_caution: For actual E8 -> (Spin10 x SU4)/Z4, this index may simply encode the SU4 center/diagonal quotient, not a new independent discrete gauge symmetry and NOT the proposed discrete R symmetry.
E8_driving_field_singlet_vacuum.constructive_fact: With exact Z4R, bare CEG is forbidden, but X_B*CEG/M and X_A*AB are allowed. Their F equations plus D=0 admit all three required singlet VEVs nonzero.
E8_driving_field_singlet_vacuum.not_solved: The scales vA,vB and cutoff M are inputs; X_B CEG/M is nonrenormalizable; the remaining three singlet zero modes and all additional neutral moduli need stabilization. Z4R anomalies, physical Yukawa overlaps and the full compact G2 vacuum remain open.

centralizer_Wilson_line_test.general_theorem: If any rank-one character lambda_i !=1, the T3 local-system Koszul cochain complex is acyclic (contract with a_i^-1); trivial character has H1 dimension3.
centralizer_Wilson_line_test.puncture_H1_extension: Removing a 3-ball from T3 does not change absolute H1 local-system cohomology; the pair excision affects degree3, not degree1.
centralizer_Wilson_line_test.centralizer_obstruction: Wilson-line holonomy commuting with the entire unbroken Spin10 acts trivially on its 45 adjoint generators, so its adjoint local system remains untwisted and still has 3 copies from b1=3.
centralizer_Wilson_line_test.escape: Break/lift adjoints by non-flat Higgs background, boundary/defect projections, a different three-cycle, or dynamics. Noncentral holonomy can eliminate some modes but breaks part of Spin10.
centralizer_Wilson_line_test.scope: This is flat local-system cohomology, not a sourced ALE/G2 index calculation with flux and physical boundary domains.

linearized_GR_lattice.grid: periodic 8^4 Minkowski lattice, central symmetric derivatives
linearized_GR_lattice.physical_question: An exactly gauge invariant finite difference Einstein tensor can still have spurious zero-energy Nyquist modes. A positive-norm, causal, no-doubler propagator and local constraint algebra are additional demands.
linearized_GR_lattice.scope: Linearized free GR identity, no full nonlinear gravity, no constraint/Hamiltonian dynamics, no proof of quantum unitarity.

two_copy_photon_SSR_activation.mechanism: Second copy activates locally accessible entanglement, rather than pretending that one shared photon offers unrestricted local X/Y Pauli operations.
two_copy_photon_SSR_activation.limits: Requires two identically phased copies and local phase-stable interferometers; event-ready heralding without setting bias and all optical loss rates must be included. Established SSR activation phenomenon, not a new Born-rule prediction.
